text: On catalyst at 276640b with 32 threads, 2000 partitions and no cap, create on hg38noN takes 43.8 s without --write-lcp and 45.1 s with it. The 113.7 s sufr row in results/paper1gen.tbl came from jeb's dev build of 2026-10-09, which has --write-lcp; the Makefile never passes it, so that row is the same workload. On 2026-11-05 that binary took 105.9 s and dev at c69cc0a 111.1 s. vendor/sufr/sufr-main, the release-era binary that always writes the LCP, took 368 s and wrote a byte-identical .sufr.
